onboarding.capabilities: On-device models · Self-hosted servers · API providers
onboarding.personaDescription: Choose how you appear in conversations. Your description helps characters get to know you.
onboarding.personaLater: You can change this later in User Personas.
onboarding.localDescription: Run downloaded models on your device. Model size and speed depend on your hardware.
onboarding.remoteDescription: Use an API provider or a model running on your own computer.
onboarding.modeLater: You can switch between Local and Remote from the side menu.
onboarding.connectionReadyHint: You can choose a model and manage connections later in Connections.
onboarding.selfHostedDescription: Connect to an OpenAI-compatible server on your own machine.
onboarding.models.idle: Enter your connection details to load available models.
onboarding.models.failed: Could not load models. Check the address and credentials, then retry. You can also choose a model later.
onboarding.connectionLater: You can change providers any time in the Connections menu.
onboarding.appearanceLater: You can change themes and chat styling later in Settings → Appearance.
onboarding.readyDescription:
A default character will be generated for you to chat with.

 Made a mistake? Don't worry.
All settings can be changed anytime.
onboarding.autoLoadHint: Your model will load automatically when you send a message in local mode.
onboarding.noRecommendations: Model recommendations are coming soon. You can import or link a GGUF model below.
onboarding.storageSection: Use a model you already have
